seoTitle: Douglas County School District Calendar 2025-2026 | Holidays & PDF
seoDescription: View the DCSD 2025-2026 school calendar with the August 13 first day, May 29 last day, 173 student days, breaks, teacher days, and official PDF.
heroSummary: Douglas County School District begins the 2025-26 conventional school year on Wednesday, August 13, 2025, and the last student day is Friday, May 29, 2026. The PDF lists 173 student days, Fall Break on October 13-17, Winter Break on December 22-January 2, and Spring Break on March 16-20. The color key separately marks teacher work, professional development, compensation, orientation, and district holiday dates.
calendarNotes: The 2025-26 DCSD conventional calendar lists 173 student days. The first student day is August 13, 2025, and the last student day is May 29, 2026. Fall Break runs October 13-17. Thanksgiving closure spans November 24-28, with November 26 marked as a compensation day and November 27-28 marked as district holidays. Winter Break runs December 22-January 2, with January 5 reserved for teacher work before the second semester begins January 6. Spring Break runs March 16-20, followed by a professional development day on April 24 and a compensation day on April 27.

customSections.label: What the DCSD Calendar Markers Mean
customSections.content: The DCSD PDF uses a color key with more detail than a simple holiday list. Those distinctions matter when families are planning student care, staff schedules, transportation, or a delayed return after a break.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Douglas County School District start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day of the DCSD 2025-26 conventional calendar is Wednesday, August 13, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is DCSD Winter Break in 2025-26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 22, 2025 through January 2, 2026. Students return after the January 5 teacher work day, with the second semester beginning January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of DCSD school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Friday, May 29, 2026. June 1 is marked as a teacher work day on the official calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the DCSD 2025-26 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official DCSD calendar identifies 173 all-day student sessions.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the DCSD calendar download update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import based on the dates listed here and will not update automatically if DCSD revises the PDF.
